verdict.rationale: Render explicitly supports deploying background workers/agents and processes 'at scale, without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic,' and its Workflows SDKs (TypeScript/Python) let users define and trigger long-running background tasks autonomously. This directly matches the story of setting up autonomous background automations on the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron-based triggers and independent hands-on validation of long-running autonomous jobs.
